verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents connecting Bitbucket Cloud to external CI/CD tools such as Bamboo or Jenkins, and says third-party code reports can be viewed from the PR screen. It also mentions standardized merge checks. None of this states that external CI build results appear as status checks on commits or pull requests, so the core story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a build-status API or status display on commits/PRs, merge checks that gate on external build status, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
